1906.method: Zhang skeletonization of a 1 m road-area mask after subtracting building/heritage footprints and river polygons. Adjacent junction pixels consolidated; degree-2 nodes merged. Edges outside the corridor rejected; no gap-bridging is used. Explicit shared endpoints define network connections.
1906.interpretation: Automatically inferred paths, not surveyed street axes. Narrow/sub-grid alleys and access through open areas require review. Separate components are retained rather than joined through buildings.

metrics.connectivity: number of directly adjacent path parts
metrics.mean_depth: mean shortest-path steps to reachable path parts
metrics.integration_1_md: reciprocal mean depth within the connected component; null when isolated
